normalized.title: Purchase of a LiDAR Aerial Scanning System, CyI/STARC/LIDAR-SCANNER/2021
normalized.description: The STARC of The Cyprus Institute is required to proceed with the purchase of a LiDAR Aerial Scanning System. Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS), also commonly known by the acronym LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging), is a rapid, highly accurate, and efficient remote sensing technique using laser light to record the surface of the earth, specifically the 3D topography of large areas of terrain, and objects appearing on it. Since LiDAR is an active system, it is independent of natural sunlight and therefore operates in all clear weather conditions - day or night. The system that fulfils the identified research requirements should be an ultra-compact and lightweight (1.5kg – 2kg) 3D laser mapping and aerial remote sensing solution for drones which can be deployed in industrial and research applications.
